idea-plugin.name: Jewel Shell Sample
idea-plugin.description: Sample of running the IntelliJ Platform under a custom UI shell rendered with Jewel (Compose for Desktop). Modeled on the LightEdit implementation: a custom ApplicationStarter boots the full platform without ever constructing the standard IDE frame, and shows a Jewel-rendered window that hosts real platform editors as Swing islands. Start the IDE with the "jewelShell" command-line argument to activate it.
